title: O'Blood, Dirt and Cum
tagline: SkyrimNet knows when someone is dirty, bloody or bathing (Dirt and Blood) and when someone has cum on them (OCum). Each is optional; with both, a bath washes the cum off. NPCs can walk to nearby real water to wash.
description: SkyrimNet companion for Dirt and Blood - Dynamic Visuals and/or OCum. Each is optional and detected at run time; at least one is needed. With Dirt and Blood: a character_bio prompt states plain facts about dirt and blood, plus state events, bath memories and a WashUp action that follows Dirt and Blood's soap and water rules (a companion, not a replacement). Since 0.5, WashUp can walk the bather to nearby real water (streams, lakes, waterfalls, pools and tubs; fake decorative water is ignored), nearby non-followers can wash if that toggle is on, and a user_final_instructions submodule states that open and communal bathing, and intimacy in those places, is ordinary Skyrim custom. With OCum: a short "### Cum covering" fact tells SkyrimNet who has cum on them, only when OStimNet's own OCum description has nothing to say. With both: any real Dirt and Blood bath also washes OCum's cum off. By That Guy (Coronerra).
author: That Guy (Coronerra)
